risks.note: Management flags that a significant portion of the Company's revenue is derived from a limited number of properties and geographic locations, which may increase vulnerability to localized market downturns, tenant defaults or regulatory changes. The whole business sits in one operating segment, 'Renting / Leasing of Immovable Properties', in a single geographical location - the state of Maharashtra - with only two owned properties, in Pune and Nagpur.
risks.risk: Concentration risk - revenue from a limited number of properties and locations

risks.note: The segment note states the Company is not reliant on any one customer, but that revenue contributed by each of its six customers exceeds ten percent of revenue from operations. Losing or re-pricing any one of those leases moves a disproportionate share of income.
risks.risk: Tenant concentration - a handful of customers carry the rent roll

risks.note: Management flags that volatility in interest rates and changes in financing conditions could increase debt servicing costs and impact cash flow and profitability. The financial-instruments note adds that the Company's borrowing is linked to the repo rate and is therefore floating-rate, so the Company is currently exposed to interest-rate risk. The MD&A threats list separately notes that rising interest rates have a firm impact on real estate markets and reduce customer demand.

Management flags that elevated fixed costs and finance expenses may compress margins or produce low or negative returns on certain investments, particularly during periods of subdued rental growth. The Company reported a loss before exceptional items and tax in both FY 2025-26 and the prior year.
risks.risk: Financial performance risk - elevated fixed costs and finance expenses against a small rent base

risks.note: Management flags that the Company's relatively flat organizational structure and lean team create dependency on a small number of key individuals, and that changes in KMP or shifts in workforce requirements driven by technology adoption such as AI may affect operational continuity and execution. Total workforce was 3 employees as on 31 March 2026.
risks.risk: Key management personnel and human capital dependency

risks.note: Management flags that adverse geopolitical developments or global economic headwinds could weaken investor confidence and slow demand for commercial real estate, negatively affecting leasing activity and asset valuations. The MD&A threats list adds political uncertainty - changes in leadership affecting the taxation system linked to real estate, and war between countries - and economy/affordability, where a weaker economy reduces potential customers' affordability.

The auditor's Emphasis of Matter draws attention to Note 58(ix) on title deeds of certain immovable properties: the properties are owned by and in the possession of the Company and titled in its name, but the Company's name is yet to be incorporated in the Property Tax records. The auditor's opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.
risks.risk: Property title not recorded in the Company's name in Property Tax records

risks.note: The auditor's Emphasis of Matter draws attention to Note 28.3 on unpaid Employee's Contribution to the Provident Fund and Employer's Contribution towards the Employee's Pension Scheme for the months from September 2025 to March 2026, attributed to technical issues encountered while remitting the amounts electronically. The auditor's opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: G. G. Dandekar Properties Limited is a small Pune-based commercial real-estate company operating in a single vertical - leasing of commercial property - with owned office properties in Pune and Nagpur generating steady lease rental income in the form of license fees.

business_model.title: Business (RHP)
business_model.body: The Company is engaged in the real estate leasing business and, during FY 2025-26, continued to operate in only one vertical: commercial real estate - leasing of commercial property. It owns properties in Pune and Nagpur which are let out to occupiers and generate lease rental income in the form of license fees. Alongside leasing, the Company provides allied services to occupants such as upkeep and maintenance of the property, security and housekeeping, for which it charges maintenance fees separately at monthly intervals.

The only forward-looking asset-related development is organisational rather than capital: after the end of the financial year the Company entered into a Service Agreement with Bootstart Spaces and Hospitality Private Limited …

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Management flags that a significant portion of the Company's revenue is derived from a limited number of properties and geographic locations, which may increase vulnerability to localized market downturns, tenant defaults or regulatory changes. The whole business sits in one operating segment, 'Renting / Leasing of Immovable Properties', in a single geographical location - the state of Maharashtra - with only two owned properties, in Pune and Nagpur.
- The segment note states the Company is not reliant on any one customer, but that revenue contributed by each of its six customers exceeds ten percent of revenue from operations. Losing or re-pricing any one of those leases moves a disproportionate share of income.
- Management flags that volatility in interest rates and changes in financing conditions could increase debt servicing costs and impact cash flow and profitability. The financial-instruments note adds that the Company's borrowing is linked to the repo rate and is therefore floating-rate, so the Company is currently exposed to interest-rate risk. The MD&A threats list separately notes that rising interest rates have a firm impact on real estate markets and reduce customer demand.
- Management flags that elevated fixed costs and finance expenses may compress margins or produce low or negative returns on certain investments, particularly during periods of subdued rental growth. The Company reported a loss before exceptional items and tax in both FY 2025-26 and the prior year.
- Management flags that the Company's relatively flat organizational structure and lean team create dependency on a small number of key individuals, and that changes in KMP or shifts in workforce requirements driven by technology adoption such as AI may affect operational continuity and execution. Total workforce was 3 employees as on 31 March 2026.
- Management flags that adverse geopolitical developments or global economic headwinds could weaken investor confidence and slow demand for commercial real estate, negatively affecting leasing activity and asset valuations. The MD&A threats list adds political uncertainty - changes in leadership affecting the taxation system linked to real estate, and war between countries - and economy/affordability, where a weaker economy reduces potential customers' affordability.
- The auditor's Emphasis of Matter draws attention to Note 58(ix) on title deeds of certain immovable properties: the properties are owned by and in the possession of the Company and titled in its name, but the Company's name is yet to be incorporated in the Property Tax records. The auditor's opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.
- The auditor's Emphasis of Matter draws attention to Note 28.3 on unpaid Employee's Contribution to the Provident Fund and Employer's Contribution towards the Employee's Pension Scheme for the months from September 2025 to March 2026, attributed to technical issues encountered while remitting the amounts electronically. The auditor's opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.
